tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: Lists the websites (domains) in the Anole account with their crawl status and average score.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Returns the Anole plan, plan limits, AI credit balance and site usage of the account.

tools.name: get_site_overview
tools.description: Crawl statistics, average AI-readiness score, llms.txt coverage and document counts for one site.

tools.name: list_urls
tools.description: Sitemap URLs of a site with their audit result. filter: all, missing_md (no Markdown version), low_score (worst first), errors (HTTP errors).

tools.name: get_url_audit
tools.description: Full audit of one URL from the site sitemap, including the stored SEO/GEO analysis when available.

tools.name: get_llms_txt
tools.description: The llms.txt file Anole serves for a site, with its public URL.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Markdown documents of a site in Content Studio. status: published (default), draft, archived or all.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Full Markdown body and metadata of one Content Studio document.

tools.name: analyze_content
tools.description: Runs the Anole SEO, readability and GEO analyzer on Markdown, HTML or a page URL of the site. Returns a 0-100 score, a traffic light and per-check results. Does not save anything.

tools.name: compare_with_top_results
tools.description: Compares a page of the site with the pages ranking in the top 10 for a search phrase: title, meta description, H1-H3 structure and heading topics, word count, paragraphs, links, images, dates and structured data. Returns the client values, medians for the top results, a list of gaps ordered by impac

tools.name: search
tools.description: Searches published documents and audited URLs of the account sites. Returns ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns the full content of a search result (id like doc:123 or url:456).

tools.name: add_site
tools.description: Adds a website (domain) to the Anole account. It is crawled in the next background cycle, or right away with crawl_site.

tools.name: crawl_site
tools.description: Starts a background crawl of the site sitemap and refreshes the audit. Returns immediately; check get_site_overview for results.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Creates a draft Markdown document in Content Studio, from Markdown text or by converting a web page (source_url) to Markdown. Drafts are not public until publish_document.

tools.name: generate_document
tools.description: Writes a draft Markdown document on a topic with the Anole AI writer and saves it in Content Studio. Uses AI credits (free with an Own Key plan). Not public until publish_document.

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Replaces the Markdown body and/or title/description of a document. The previous version is kept as a revision. A published document changes publicly at once.

tools.name: publish_document
tools.description: Publishes a document: makes its .md URL public, adds it to the site llms.txt and pushes it to the customer server when auto-deploy is configured.

tools.name: unpublish_document
tools.description: Archives a document: removes its public .md URL and its llms.txt entry. Content is kept and can be published again.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_urls, get_url_audit, get_llms_txt, analyze_content, search, fetch · Private data: get_site_overview, get_llms_txt, list_documents, get_document, search, create_document, generate_document, update_document, publish_document, unpublish_document · Public sink: publish_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_urls, get_url_audit, get_llms_txt, analyze_content, search, fetch · Private data: get_site_overview, get_llms_txt, list_documents, get_document, search, create_document, generate_document, update_document, publish_document, unpublish_document · Public sink: publish_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
